reproduction: On a native device, enable the ObraSignal Notifications setting.
Deny the operating-system notification permission prompt.
Allow `syncUnreadOpportunityAlerts()` to return after `configureNotifications()` reports permission not granted.
observed_result: Permission denial returns numeric 0 from `syncUnreadOpportunityAlerts()`. `App.js` interprets delivered===0 as `Notificações activadas.` even though OS permission is denied.
expected_truth: Permission denied must be a distinct state from enabled-with-zero-alerts.
The UI must never say notifications are active when operating-system permission is denied.
Retry/settings guidance may be shown, but denial is not success.
required_retest: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: denied permission cannot flow to the active-success notice.
PROVEN_REAL_DEVICE: Android permission denial is visibly represented as denied/not active.
PROVEN_REAL_DEVICE: permission granted with zero unread alerts may truthfully show enabled with zero new alerts.
hard_boundary: Golden Path owns acceptance/regression only; repair belongs to MOBILE_PRODUCT_OWNER.
